data.summary:
Seasoned professional with 17+ years of experience specializing in Genesys Cloud CX architecture and Avaya ecosystems. A PMP and Scrum certified leader with a strong techno-functional acumen, adept at translating complex technical intricacies into actionable business strategies. Expert in driving Agile delivery, managing product backlogs through the creation of precise User Stories, and leading high-velocity Sprints. A skilled communicator adept at managing complex stakeholder relationships, ensuring seamless alignment between cross-functional teams and executive leadership to drive project consensus. Highly proficient in Risk Management, with a proven ability to identify project vulnerabilities early and execute robust mitigation plans that ensure the successful delivery of large-scale enterprise communication solutions. Expert in navigating complex regulatory environments and delivering executive-level briefings to C-suite stakeholders and regulators.
Domain	Banking: Standard Chartered Bank, Arab National Bank, Bank Muscat, Bank Dhofar, ENBD and FAB.
FinTech: Tabby
Telecom: Etisalat (e&), Orange, Base Telecom, & Nepal Telecom
